probes: R-01 PASS 真实容器任务（确定性适配器）：result.json 与 GET /tasks/{id} 的 before_sha256 == sha256(磁盘前像)，且 != sha256(sha256(前像))；after_sha256 == 磁盘后像 == FIXED_CALC；same.py 未出现；tree_after == 重新扫描摘要；diff 仅单行 ±；基线 failed → 修复后 passed。
R-02 PASS 结构化 diff 四类语义（modified / added / deleted / unchanged）与 tree_after 均符合契约。
R-03 PASS 省略 old_sha256 + 磁盘被外部改动 → PATCH_STALE。
R-04 PASS 显式错误 old_sha256 → PATCH_HASH_MISMATCH，文件未被改动。
R-05 PASS read_file 注记由 harness 生成；文件内伪造的 <<mgar-read-file …>> 保持字面内容并整体参与哈希；伪造摘要作 old_sha256 被 PATCH_HASH_MISMATCH 拒绝；用真实注记哈希的合法编辑成功。
R-06 PASS 伪造 run_tests argv（sh -c / 追加参数 / 前缀 / 绝对路径）均为 HARNESS_COMMAND_DENIED，session 未被触碰。
R-07 PASS 增量替换删除断言仍被 H07 弱化守卫拦住（status != completed）。
R-08 PASS 65,536 字节接受，65,537 字节 PATCH_LIMIT。
R-09 PASS 多文件批量中一处前像过期 → 整批回滚。
R-12 PASS 服务层 get_task 对 ..、../..、../result、h08-../../result、./../result、/etc/passwd 全部 HARNESS_TASK_UNKNOWN，harness 根下诱饵 result.json 不可读。
API-01 PASS 真实 HTTP（真实 app + 真实认证）：13 种畸形 id（%2e%2e、%2E%2E、编码斜杠、双重编码、点段、空白、短/长、非十六进制、大写、%00、未知合法 id）在 /tasks/{id}、/patch、/artifacts 均 404，诱饵内容未泄露。
R-10 GAP（残余）变更集中出现非 UTF-8 文件时 CodingWorkspace.diff 抛 WORKSPACE_BINARY（修复前静默跳过该文件）；容器内测试对工作区只读（R-11 实测 PermissionError），写路径仅文本，当前无法由 H08 执行面触发；属失败关闭而非绕过。

blocking.title: changes[].before_sha256 was a double hash
blocking.detail: CodingWorkspace.diff() passed the baseline path->sha256 map entry through sha256_text() again, so every modified file reported sha256(baseline digest) instead of the baseline digest.
blocking.reproduced: calc.py baseline e1a894022d1a082987b87adecb623438c9e386d86b2b621cff4a5fe7fdf7edc8 reported as 78375a61cbb532340246f6f0dfd1aa63ef04ffc76073b36d63f6a0b60201abcf, matching sha256("e1a894...") exactly.
blocking.fix: CodingWorkspace.diff() now reports the baseline digest string verbatim; deletions report sha256("") and added files report before_sha256=null, matching the H07 LocalWorkspace reference. Changed files are enumerated from TaskWorkspace.status() over the baseline/scan union.
blocking.mutation_check: Read-only reproduction: sha256_text('def add(a, b):\n    return a - b\n') = e1a894...; the old expression sha256_text(<digest>) = 78375a...; both fixed assertions (before_sha256 == baseline digest, before_sha256 != sha256(digest)) fail under the old expression.

hardening.title: task_id was not validated
hardening.detail: GET /api/v3/harness/tasks/%2e%2e decoded to '..' and resolved <harness_root>/result.json with 200.
hardening.fix: HarnessCodingService.get_task() now requires fullmatch of ^h08-[0-9a-f]{12}$ before touching the filesystem; any other id raises HARNESS_TASK_UNKNOWN (404). patch_path() goes through get_task() and is covered by the same guard.
hardening.tests: tests/test_harness_v4_h08.py::test_web_api_rejects_malformed_task_ids covers encoded dots, encoded slashes, empty/short/long ids, non-hex and uppercase ids, NUL, and an unknown-but-well-formed id; both /tasks/{id} and /tasks/{id}/patch must 404.
